name: superspec
description: Shared browser preview and editor for the SuperSpec Rust compiler.

scripts.dev:native: npm run build:native-viewer && cargo run --release --locked -p superspec-cli --bin superspec-studio -- serve
scripts.check:sdk: cargo run --quiet --locked -p superspec-cli --bin superspec-studio -- sdk --out generated/material-sdk && tsc -p tests/sdk-types/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --test tests/browser/rust-packet.test.ts tests/browser/rust-updates.test.ts tests/browser/rust-batches.test.ts tests/browser/studio-archive.test.ts tests/browser/rust-lighting.test.ts tests/browser/placement-preview.test.ts tests/browser/atlas.test.ts tests/browser/bake-graph.test.ts tests/browser/city-materials.test.mjs tests/published-city-bench.test.mjs tests/graphics-profiles.test.mjs tests/published-city-throughput.test.mjs
scripts.test:city-runtime: node --experimental-transform-types --test tests/browser/city-runtime.test.ts tests/browser/city-lod-binding.test.ts tests/browser/gltf-lights.test.ts tests/browser/city-vegetation.test.ts tests/browser/city-texture-loader.test.ts tests/browser/city-texture-residency.test.ts tests/browser/packet-lods.test.ts tests/browser/packet-material-lods.test.ts tests/browser/declared-lods.test.ts tests/browser/block-lods.test.ts tests/browser/shop-lights.test.ts tests/browser/outline-depth.test.ts tests/browser/city-shadow-cache.test.ts tests/browser/glazing.test.ts tests/browser/distant-glazing.test.ts tests/browser/hardware-bounce.test.ts tests/browser/texture-channels.test.ts tests/browser/world-warmup.test.ts tests/browser/first-frame-programs.test.ts tests/browser/world-scene.test.ts tests/browser/tinted-instances.test.ts
